# Potato Apparel

> Potato Apparel is a custom OEM/ODM clothing manufacturer based in Guangzhou, China, working through a vetted network of specialist garment factories. We help independent brands, DTC/e-commerce sellers, and streetwear labels produce custom apparel with a low minimum order quantity (50 pieces per style), 7–10 day sampling, AQL 2.5 quality inspection, OEKO-TEX Standard 100 fabrics, and worldwide DDP shipping.

Key facts:
- Minimum order quantity (MOQ): 50 pieces per style, colors and sizes can be mixed
- Sampling: 7–10 business days; bulk production typically 25–35 days after sample approval
- Decoration: screen printing, embroidery (up to 15,000 stitches), DTG, DTF, puff print, sublimation, garment washes
- Fabrics: OEKO-TEX Standard 100 certified options; recycled (GRS-documentable) options
- Quality: AQL 2.5 inspection with photo + measurement report on every order
- Shipping: DDP (door-to-door, duties paid) and FOB; serves USA, UK, Australia, EU, Middle East
- Model: a manufacturing partner managing a vetted network of specialist factories (not a single owned factory)

## Manufacturing (custom apparel by garment type)
- [Custom T-Shirt Manufacturer](https://www.potatoapparel.com/en/manufacturing/custom-t-shirts): Premium tees 160–320 GSM, combed ring-spun cotton, low MOQ.
- [Custom Hoodie Manufacturer](https://www.potatoapparel.com/en/manufacturing/custom-hoodies): Fleece & French terry 280–480 GSM, full custom branding.
- [Custom Sweatshirt Manufacturer](https://www.potatoapparel.com/en/manufacturing/custom-sweatshirts): Crew-neck and pullover sweatshirts 280–400 GSM.
- [Custom Streetwear Manufacturer](https://www.potatoapparel.com/en/manufacturing/custom-streetwear): Heavyweight tees, fleece, oversized fits, garment washes.
- [Custom Activewear Manufacturer](https://www.potatoapparel.com/en/manufacturing/custom-activewear): Performance fabrics (poly/nylon/spandex, recycled), flatlock seaming.
- [Custom Polo Shirt Manufacturer](https://www.potatoapparel.com/en/manufacturing/custom-polo-shirts): Piqué cotton & performance polos for corporate and golf.
- [Custom Joggers & Sweatpants Manufacturer](https://www.potatoapparel.com/en/manufacturing/custom-joggers-sweatpants): 280–420 GSM, custom pockets, waistbands, hems.
- [Custom Shorts Manufacturer](https://www.potatoapparel.com/en/manufacturing/custom-shorts): Gym, cargo, board and sweat shorts.
- [Custom Denim Manufacturer](https://www.potatoapparel.com/en/manufacturing/custom-denim): Jeans, jackets, shorts; full wash & distress program.
- [Y2K Clothing Manufacturer](https://www.potatoapparel.com/en/manufacturing/y2k-clothing): Acid/pigment/vintage washes, baby tees, cropped fits.
- [Custom Kids' Clothing Manufacturer](https://www.potatoapparel.com/en/manufacturing/custom-kids-clothing): OEKO-TEX fabrics, sizes 2T–14Y.
- [Custom Swimwear Manufacturer](https://www.potatoapparel.com/en/manufacturing/custom-swimwear): UPF 50+ nylon/spandex & ECONYL®, sublimation.
- [Custom Dress Manufacturer](https://www.potatoapparel.com/en/manufacturing/custom-dresses): Bodycon, wrap, shirt, maxi in woven & knit.

## For specific audiences
- [Clothing Manufacturer for Amazon FBA Sellers](https://www.potatoapparel.com/en/clothing-manufacturer-for/amazon-fba-sellers): FNSKU labeling, poly-bagging, FBA-compliant prep.
- [Clothing Manufacturer for Shopify & DTC Brands](https://www.potatoapparel.com/en/clothing-manufacturer-for/shopify-dtc-brands): Full custom branding, launch-small-scale-winners.
- [Clothing Manufacturer for Startups & Small Brands](https://www.potatoapparel.com/en/clothing-manufacturer-for/startups-and-small-brands): Low MOQ, hands-on guidance from sketch to delivery.
- [Clothing Manufacturer for Streetwear Brands](https://www.potatoapparel.com/en/clothing-manufacturer-for/streetwear-brands): Heavyweight weights, washes, drop-friendly MOQ.
